mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate compresses discount rates for equity valuation, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 5.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in employment (PAYEMS) and housing starts (HOUST) signal strong consumer demand and business investment, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where both PAYEMS and HOUST have increased for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: In high-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL YoY change > 5.0%), a rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS increasing for 3 months) triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY change exceeds 5.0% and FEDFUNDS has risen for 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in housing starts above 0.5% signals robust consumer demand, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where HOUST has increased by more than 0.5% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in industrial production (INDPRO) and GDP (GDPC1) above 0.3% quarterly signals robust economic expansion, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where both INDPRO and GDPC1 have grown by more than 0.3% quarterly.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year increase in the CPI index above 5.0% signals persistent inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to the threat of aggressive monetary policy.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY change exceeds 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in consumer spending (RSAFS) combined with rising housing starts (HOUST) signals strong economic activity, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where both RSAFS and HOUST have increased for 3 consecutive months.
